newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Crocodile kills Israeli tourist in Costa Rica.
newsitem.headline: Crocodile kills Israeli tourist in Costa Rica.

text.p: A giant crocodile attacked and killed an Israeli tourist as he swam in a lagoon in eastern Costa Rica, officials said on Wednesday.

Ronen Gilad, 23, jumped into the lagoon for a swim on Tuesday afternoon and was attacked by an 10ft-long (3 metre) crocodile in the Mondonguillo nature preserve, some 50 miles (80 km) east of the capital San Jose.
The crocodile tried to eat Gilad, and dragged him to the bottom of the lagoon, where the young man drowned, police said.
"Gilad found himself faced with a gigantic crocodile and despite his efforts could not save himself," a police statement said on Wednesday.

The statement said Gilad had been warned that crocodiles abounded in the nature preserve, where he was visiting in a government sponsored programme to teach visitors about the region's flora and fauna.
Yoed Magen, consul general of Israel in Costa Rica, told Reuters Gilad was from the small town of Givatayim, just outside Tel Aviv. He said the body would be returned to Israel shortly.
